turkanime.isim: Jigoku Sensei Nube: Kyoufu no Natsuyasumi!! Ayashi no Umi no Densetsu!
turkanime.ozet: Nube ve sınıfı, plajda vakit geçirmek için küçük bir adaya giderler. Oradaki yaşlı bir adamdan yasaklanmış bir efsane duyarlar. Bu efsaneye göre deniz örümceği olarak bilinen yaratık 200. yılında dolunaya ulaştığında iblise dönüşecek ve insanları yiyecekti. Aniden ortaya çıkan bir kız çocuklarla iyi geçinerek birlikte oyun oynarlar. Bu sırada tuhaflıklar başlar.

jikan.title: Jigoku Sensei Nube: Kyoufu no Natsuyasumi!! Ayashi no Umi no Densetsu!
jikan.title_english: Hell Teacher Nube: Summer Holiday of Fear! Legend of the Sea of Suspicion
jikan.synopsis: When Nube and his class arrive at a small island to carry out beach activities, they heard a forbodding tale from an old man residing on the island. Legend has it that there is a creature known as the sea spider in the open seas around the island. When the creature is past 200 years old, it will turn into a monster and devour humans to satisfy its appetite. However, curiousity kills the cat and Yukime decides to pursue the authenticity of the legend. And then, a girl suddenly appears on the beach. Possessed with a strange charm, she immediately attracts Hiroshi's attention and overcomes him. Soon later, strange things start to happen to the others whereby Kyoko and Ritsuko-sensei got attacked under strange circumstances. The true identity behind the mysterious girl is questioned and the legend behind the sea creature seems to be true after all.
